text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Returning to the waiting room, Duramente seemed
completely calm, just as she always was.
choice_data_list: Congratulations, that was an undeniable run!
Congratulations, that run was simply flawless!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...No. Today's run wasn't
something worthy of being called the 'strongest.'"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Witnessing "the descent of the strongest," the crowd goes wild—
and gazes in awe.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: What I strive for is the overwhelming strength I witnessed that day.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I haven't reached that level yet.
choice_data_list: But getting into the habit of winning is a good thing.
If you grow more than anyone else, you'll definitely reach it!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: A habit of winning... huh. Fair enough.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"If one is the strongest, constant victory is natural.
Perhaps delivering results that make it seem only natural is also part of being the strongest."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
That is where the meaning of continuing to win lies.
Let us keep moving forward without pause, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I never had any intention of letting anyone catch up to me in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Surpassing my limits, I will continue to surpass myself.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"To do that means training, huh.
Let's push ourselves even harder than before."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: At the end of that path lies the strength I seek.
